purpose: Minimal falsifiable computational core for relational state, deterministic evolution, observation, and verification.

objects.state: S_t: finite machine-readable state at logical time t
objects.context: C_t: declared external inputs authorized for one transition
objects.observer: O: declared procedure or actor that obtains observations without redefining state semantics
objects.trajectory: tau: finite ordered sequence of authorized observation actions or viewpoints
objects.observation_contract: finite preconditions + trajectory + budget + expected predicate + explicit failure condition

non_goals: treat absence in one unauthorized/static observation as proof of semantic absence
